requiredAdapterProperties: Use a reviewed strict original-request sanitizer that retains the literal initial HTTP scheme and host/path/query; distinguish URI identity from canonical content reuse. Do not mutate the loaded collector snapshot or globally remove its safety policy.
Use the scheme-preserving strict identity in page_live_event accounting and any direct-gap dedup/cache/event matching; existing content key() intentionally folds schemes and is insufficient proof.
Preserve the pinned collector public ordinary origin, scheme, credential, port, local/IP-literal and authentication checks; never bypass PublicFetcher/gates with raw transport.

Run robots for the actual HTTP origin before its page; existing HTTPS robots is not HTTP-origin authorization. Follow only observed HTTP Location redirects, applying target auth/robots and shared gate at every hop.

Preserve v2 shared host serialization, cooldowns on 429/5xx/errors, Retry-After propagation to redirect targets before their robots/page, Profiles >=10 seconds, source hash/race guards, and bounded request limits.

Persist actual HTTP requestedUrl/sourceUrl, observedAt, status/headers and real redirect chain/body hash, including failure or robots precheck outcomes. Never copy the existing HTTPS observation/body/time onto the HTTP URI.

Update direct-check/verified URL evidence only after the real original URI result is inspected; an HTTP 200, real redirect, error, challenge or robots refusal are all possible and remain unknown in this review.
boundaryNotes: Historical baseline websiteCheck values are preserved and not declared nonexistent. The gap is the current-round strict direct-request proof, not a claim that no historical HTTP check ever occurred.

Related HTTPS content acceptance is reused from existing reviewed records/projections; this metadata audit does not independently resynthesize research or current affiliation.

A ready coordination receipt identifies the loaded eda snapshot; mutable collector working-file hashes and historical summary live batches can differ and are not substituted for the exact loaded snapshot.
Inventory metadata review does not itself execute or authorize an immediate network request; parent must complete its adapter offline validation and bounded-request decision.
